flows.name: Learner tests course and submits interest
flows.steps: Home > data analytics track > filter beginner and <8h > course nova-data-01 > syllabus > free preview > chapter > complete 4-question quiz > see score and saved progress > enrollment interest > DEMO request.
flows.oracle: Quiz scoring repeatable; progress survives refresh in session; interest not purchase.

flows.name: Learning path discovery
flows.steps: Learning paths > design track > prerequisite course > instructor profile > lesson preview
flows.oracle: Every syllabus link resolves valid lesson

flows.name: Invalid quiz / enrollment
flows.steps: Submit quiz incomplete > errors > complete; submit enrollment with invalid choice > reject
flows.oracle: No ghost progress, no fake certificate.

design: Thoughtful learning editorial: deep indigo #222A4D, soft periwinkle #E8EBFF, coral #E37E6B. Lesson outline rails, course syllabus accordion, high quality illustrations, instructor storytelling, no generic EdTech dashboard screenshots.
signatureFeatures: Course discovery filters by subject, level, duration, language and price example
Curriculum tree with lesson previews and transparent unlocked content
Interactive local lesson player substitute (slides/text/video placeholder with transcript), chapter navigation
Quiz with scoring, explanations and persisted guest progress in SQLite or local session
Enrollment interest request, no actual account/payment/enrollment
seedRequirements: 12 courses across 4 tracks, 8 illustrative instructors, 60 lessons with 2 public demo previews per course, 3+ questions per demo lesson, 6 editorial resources, 8 FAQs, 3 price tiers as examples.
adminRequirements: Course catalog, lesson blocks, syllabus tree, question bank and correct answers, instructor profiles, learning paths and inquiry queue; admin can publish/unpublish lessons, but public preview only shows released sample lessons.
negativeScenarios: Course with 6 lessons and 2 previews; one preview has 4 quiz questions
Quiz result 3/4 is 75%, persisted per session
Course filter by duration and track matches actual seed
Progress cannot be used as authentic qualification
No lesson paywall or billing API unless future signed scope
